mentions.name: Convek
mentions.description: API for soaring-specific weather data based on RASP, aimed at paragliders and instrument makers, with widgets and daily emails for gliding clubs. Currently has 24 sign-ups and ~5 active users with one paying subscriber, and is expanding to cover every country while waiting for users to add another compute server since RASP is compute-heavy.
mentions.problem: Soaring-specific weather data was not previously available via an API (described as the first one).
mentions.audience: Paragliders, instrument makers, and gliding clubs
mentions.source_excerpt:
Convek https://convek.dev/
It's an API (first one) for soaring specific weather data, based on RASP, for paragliders, instrument makers etc.
24 sign ups and ~5 active users, no subscribers yet (one person paid for a month though!).
Along with widgets and daily emails for gliding clubs.
